rule: A family is one base mob class (stats, AI, loot) plus one sprite class on one shared sheet. A variant is a subclass that changes one thing: (a) a frame block in the same sheet selected by an offset (rat 0, albino +16, fetid +32; gnoll 0, exile +21, trickster +42; mimic 0 / gold +16 / crystal +32 / ebony +48; caustic slime +9), (b) one on-hit or on-damage effect or one flag (albino bleed on a coin flip, caustic slime ooze on a coin flip, acidic ooze on hit and on being struck while adjacent, phantom piranha halves damage when the attacker is not adjacent), and sometimes (c) a stat row (albino base HP is higher than the rat). Spawn: each rotation slot swaps to its variant with a chance of 1 in 50 times an exotic multiplier. Depth scaling is a formula per family with a floor (elemental region scale never below 2).
keep: One sheet per family with frame blocks; the variant keeps the base outline
One swapped effect per variant (one readable tag), not a bundle
Rare alt swap inside the spawn group (1 in N per slot), not a per-spawn coin on every mob
Depth formulas per family with a floor, so the early zone never goes to zero
Boss roster built from known family members (summons reuse base classes)
change: Java subclass per variant becomes a data row (family id plus overrides)
Hidden random swap in the elemental picker becomes an explicit row
No stacking of base and variant effects on one hit (caustic and acidic both ooze)
Our own sheet, silhouettes, names and palette; no copied frame layouts or art
At most 3 attackers per group: at most one variant per group of 3 by default
look_test: Build one 375-wide fragment with four creatures: a base sewer vermin, its pale variant with a bleed tag on first hit, an elemental-tinted variant from the same body, and a mimic prop from the same sheet. Dom judges whether the family reads in one second and whether the variant tag reads without text. Second pass: the same group at alt rate 1 in 50 and 1 in 10, to see which feels like a surprise rather than a pattern.
